architecture: Cell-based hot-swappable CRAM schemas with CompositeSchema chaining

schemas.name: CRAM_NS
schemas.description: Core NS: divergence/boundary sieve, momentum residual, exact stencils

schemas.name: CRAM_NS_TURBULENCE
schemas.description: Multi-scale energy cascade, Kolmogorov spectrum, band-decomposed advection

schemas.name: CRAM_NS_VORTEX
schemas.description: Vortex identification/tracking, circulation conservation, Biot-Savart in CRT

schemas.name: CRAM_NS_MULTISCALE
schemas.description: Hierarchical refinement via Infinite Scaffold, restriction/prolongation, AMR

schemas.name: CRAM_NS_REGULARITY
schemas.description: BKM criterion, beta certificate, discrete max principle, 2D proof / 3D probe

schemas.name: CRAM_YUKAWA
schemas.description: Topological sieve, fusion rules, triple intersection, modular q-expansion

schemas.name: CRAM_KAHLER
schemas.description: Picard-Fuchs ODE, Frobenius series, Sp(4,Z) monodromy, Weil-Petersson metric

schemas.name: CRAM_GAP
schemas.description: Prime gap sieving, Hydra architecture, CRAM lane transforms

schemas.name: CRAM_SPECTRAL
schemas.description: PSPI/WASSAN, phase-lock, attractor basin, sector projection

schemas.name: CRAM_E8
schemas.description: Root proximity, winding stability, shell occupancy, lattice embedding

schemas.name: CRAM_CRYPTO
schemas.description: Key schedule validation, syndrome/error-locator, side-channel safety

schemas.name: CRAM_DSP
schemas.description: Signal processing, NTT band operations, spectral filtering

schemas.name: CRAM_OPTIM
schemas.description: Constrained optimization, feasibility sieve, objective scoring

schemas.name: CRAM_GEOM
schemas.description: Apollonian packing, Descartes identity, lattice geometry

schemas.name: CRAM_BIO
schemas.description: Codon residue tests, genetic code redundancy, sequence alignment

schemas.name: CRAM_ML
schemas.description: Tropical ReLU geometry, exact gradient, weight quantization

composite_pipelines.name: NS_TURBULENCE_PIPELINE
composite_pipelines.description: Multi-scale decomposition, turbulence analysis, regularity check

composite_pipelines.name: YUKAWA_KAHLER_PIPELINE
